stories.title: US Air Force pulls all bombers from UK base after suspected terror attack
stories.summary: The US Air Force has removed all of its bombers from RAF Fairford in Britain after the base was targeted in a suspected terror attack. The withdrawal underscores heightened security concerns at a key US staging base in the UK.

stories.title: Nobel medicine prize goes to three scientists for work on how nerve cells shape feelings
stories.summary: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to three scientists for research into how nerve cells shape feelings and brain activity. The work helps explain how the brain turns neural signals into sensation and emotion.

stories.title: Spain's PM calls early general election as housing crisis pressure mounts
stories.summary: Spain's prime minister has called a snap general election as public anger over the country's housing crisis intensifies. The vote is set to become a referendum on affordability and the government's handling of soaring rents and prices.

stories.title: Russia escalates attacks on Ukraine, targeting bridges in Kyiv with drones
stories.summary: Russia stepped up its assault on Ukraine, with drone strikes targeting bridges in the capital Kyiv. The attacks mark a further intensification of Moscow's campaign against Ukrainian infrastructure.

stories.title: Trump taps intelligence chief Jay Clayton to lead new AI task force
stories.summary: President Trump has chosen his national intelligence director, Jay Clayton, to head a new 'Super Intelligence' AI task force. The appointment puts an intelligence official in charge of shaping federal AI policy.

stories.title: Google's unannounced Fitbit Edge leaks with a screen and Pixel 11 colors
stories.summary: Google's unreleased Fitbit Edge leaked online, showing a new screen-equipped wearable alongside Pixel 11 color options. The leak points to Google widening its Fitbit line as it readies its next phones.

stories.title: Denmark health data breach exposes personal data of 8.8 million people
stories.summary: Denmark's national health data authority, CPR, disclosed a major breach exposing the personal data of roughly 8.8 million people. It is one of the country's largest leaks of citizen data and has triggered an official review.

stories.title: Huawei and Qualcomm sign broad patent license agreement
stories.summary: Huawei and Qualcomm announced a broad patent licensing agreement covering their respective technologies. The deal resolves a long-running dispute between the telecom and chip giants.

stories.title: Browns find new swagger under bold coach Todd Monken
stories.summary: Cleveland is 3-1 and riding a three-game win streak built on close, physical finishes, and cleveland.com credits head coach Todd Monken's aggressive decision-making for the team's new swagger.

stories.title: Browns news roundup: an opportunity to change the narrative
stories.summary: Dawgs By Nature's daily roundup frames the week as a chance for the Browns to change their season's narrative, covering Jerry Jeudy, safety Emmanuel McNeil-Warren and quarterback Dillon Gabriel.

stories.title: Browns' defensive line answers the call despite mounting injuries
stories.summary: Cleveland's defensive line keeps producing even as injuries test its depth, holding up as a key reason the Browns sit at 3-1.

stories.title: Browns' win over Steelers keeps six remarkable streaks alive
stories.summary: Cleveland's 27-24 win over Pittsburgh kept six notable streaks going, including its run of one-score victories, as the Browns improved to 3-1 in the AFC North.

stories.title: Off-Script Ohio: Iowa recap, defensive turnaround and what comes next
stories.summary: Yahoo's Off-Script Ohio breaks down Ohio State's 31-14 win at Iowa, the Buckeyes' defensive turnaround and what lies ahead. Ohio State stayed at No. 5 in the AP poll after the victory.

stories.title: Grading Ohio State's offense vs. Iowa: Sayin and Smith lead historic day
stories.summary: cleveland.com graded the Buckeyes' offense against Iowa, where Julian Sayin and Jeremiah Smith powered a historic performance in the 31-14 road win.

stories.title: Grading Ohio State's defense vs. Iowa: Jackson and Russaw stand out
stories.summary: Ohio State's defense earned strong marks for its performance against Iowa, with Kenyatta Jackson and Qua Russaw among the standouts in the 31-14 win.

stories.title: Jeremiah Smith can break another Ohio State record this week vs. Maryland
stories.summary: Buckeye Breakfast notes that Jeremiah Smith can break yet another school record this week when Ohio State hosts Maryland for homecoming.

stories.title: The added consequence of George Russell's Malaysia retirement
stories.summary: George Russell's late DNF in Malaysia carries extra consequences for the 2026 title race, further denting his hopes of reeling in Mercedes teammate Andrea Kimi Antonelli.

stories.title: Christian Horner responds to Red Bull's Malaysia win with Ford
stories.summary: Christian Horner reacted to Red Bull's Malaysia victory, calling it a milestone for the team and its new Ford-backed power unit.

stories.title: 'Even faster than Ferrari' - Alonso grabs Aston Martin's best 2026 result
stories.summary: Fernando Alonso delivered Aston Martin's best result of the 2026 season in Malaysia, a boost the team hopes to build on as it fights through the midfield.

stories.title: Bahrain Grand Prix draws record-breaking crowd at Sepang
stories.summary: The Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia drew a record crowd at Sepang, with 261,000 fans attending across the weekend.

stories.title: Players report Tarkov is 'unplayable' since latest server maintenance
stories.summary: A thread on r/EscapefromTarkov reports the game has become 'unplayable' since the most recent server maintenance, with players citing connection and stability problems.

stories.title: Ohio senator calls for federal gas tax relief
stories.summary: An Ohio senator is pushing for federal gas tax relief, arguing drivers need a break at the pump as the state's own gas tax holiday takes effect.

stories.title: One dead, one hospitalized after southeast Columbus shooting
stories.summary: One person was killed and another hospitalized after a shooting in southeast Columbus, according to police.

stories.title: After Tennessee's failed execution, a look at Ohio's history of botched executions
stories.summary: Following Tennessee's failed execution of Christa Pike, NBC4 examines Ohio's own record of botched executions and what it means for the death penalty debate.

stories.title: Five Haitians from Springfield, Ohio, deported after protected status ends
stories.summary: Five Haitians living in Springfield, Ohio, have been deported after the Trump administration ended their protected status. The removals highlight the policy shift's impact on Ohio immigrant communities.
